answer: A cheap defence is to anchor each agent to one long-lived key plus a small stake it loses if it misbehaves, so spinning up a hundred fake agents costs real money instead of nothing. A new identity starts with narrow permissions, like a single plume of smoke you can watch, and only earns wider access after a history of honest work. Seen through a prism of past jobs, vouches, and penalties, a sybil swarm stands out, because the fakes share thin, identical records.
